title: SORA — Sound, shaped around you

creativeDirection.objective: Introduce a fictional premium over-ear headphone through form, tactile detail and a memorable hero reveal.
creativeDirection.audience: Design-conscious listeners discovering the object for the first time.
creativeDirection.concept: A four-beat reveal moves from material texture to silhouette, tactile interface and complete product.

visualSystem.typography: Editorial grotesk, oversized uppercase headlines and small tracked metadata.
visualSystem.composition: Asymmetric product framing, deliberate negative space and close crops.
visualSystem.lighting: Directional studio key light with warm edge highlights and deep readable shadows.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Matte graphite polymer, brushed aluminium and soft-touch ear cushions.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: Macro push-in, shape-matched hard cuts, short lateral move, then a slow push that settles into a still hero frame.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Original restrained electronic pulse, soft material Foley, one closing impact; no narration.
assumptions: SORA is a fictional product created only for this benchmark; no real specifications are claimed.
rightsAndFactualConstraints: All vector artwork is original and generated for this repository; no third-party logos or recordings.

shots.purpose: Hook with a tactile, abstract material reveal.
shots.visual: Extreme crop of the headphone earcup rim; a warm highlight travels across brushed metal while most of the object remains concealed.
shots.framing: Extreme macro, diagonal crop, object enters from the right.
shots.cameraMovement: Slow push-in with a short highlight sweep.
shots.transition: Cut from near-black as the edge catches light.
shots.audio: Soft brushed-metal texture, pulse begins quietly.
shots.action: A cropped headphone rim emerges as a highlight travels along its edge.
shots.visualProgression: Start: near-black frame. Development: the moving highlight reveals material and rim shape. End: a clear edge shape becomes the match-cut cue.

shots.purpose: Reveal the complete silhouette and establish product identity.
shots.visual: A three-quarter view of the headphones floats against warm ivory; the headband and both earcups read clearly.
shots.framing: Medium-wide product shot, object right of centre with large copy area left.
shots.cameraMovement: Gentle orbit impression through layered parallax and slow scale move.
shots.transition: Shape-match cut from the circular rim to the full earcup.
shots.audio: Pulse opens; a soft low whoosh follows the reveal.
shots.visualMethod: 2D product motion graphics with layered parallax
shots.action: The full headphone silhouette appears and rotates through a three-quarter presentation.
shots.visualProgression: Start: only the earcup rim is visible. Development: headband and both earcups emerge as layers shift. End: the complete silhouette is readable.

shots.purpose: Give the viewer a tactile detail to remember.
shots.visual: Tight close-up of the earcup control and cushion seam, with a single orange control accent.
shots.framing: Tight asymmetric close-up, shallow-angle graphic crop.
shots.cameraMovement: Short lateral slide, then a deliberate hold.
shots.audio: Quiet tactile click; music briefly recedes.
shots.action: The earcup control and cushion seam come into focus as the camera-like composition slides laterally.
shots.visualProgression: Start: tight crop obscures the control. Development: lateral movement exposes the control and seam. End: hold on the tactile detail.

shots.purpose: Resolve the reveal with a clean, iconic product frame.
shots.visual: The headphones settle into a balanced hero composition on graphite; the wordmark sits in a clean safe area.
shots.framing: Wide centred hero with generous negative space.
shots.cameraMovement: Gentle push that eases to a complete stop.
shots.transition: Cut to the hero, then hold to the end.
shots.audio: Pulse resolves with one restrained impact and a clean tail.
shots.action: The headphones settle on graphite and the wordmark appears.
shots.visualProgression: Start: product enters with residual movement. Development: it settles while the background simplifies. End: centered hero and wordmark hold.

acceptanceCriteria: Four visually distinct shot scales and compositions.
The headphone silhouette remains coherent across all four shots.
All copy is readable and stays within title-safe areas.
Each shot contains purposeful visual movement rather than a static title swap.
The final hero frame holds clearly and resolves the opening idea.

renderStrategy.rationale: This existing SORA example is authored as layered 2D product motion graphics that fit the ProjectVideo scene schema. This is a documented compatibility choice for the legacy example, not a default for new product films.
renderStrategy.fallback: If the product needs bespoke physical camera moves or 3D surfaces, build a dedicated custom product composition rather than forcing unsupported behavior into scene JSON.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: Four visually distinct shot scales and compositions.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: The macro material crop, three-quarter silhouette reveal, tight control detail and final wide hero are separate authored compositions.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: The headphone silhouette remains coherent across all four shots.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: Each original vector asset depicts the same fictional headphone design, retaining consistent earcup, headband and cushion geometry.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: All copy is readable and stays within title-safe areas.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: Each shot has its own editorial text treatment and safe-area layout; the four corresponding assets contain the copy placement.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: Each shot contains purposeful visual movement rather than a static title swap.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: Each scene defines a distinct camera-like scale, lateral or reveal movement and a clear start-to-end visual progression.

acceptanceCoverage.criterion: The final hero frame holds clearly and resolves the opening idea.
acceptanceCoverage.rationale: The opening establishes the material edge and the final hero returns to the complete product form, with a deliberate closing hold.
